search_text: 设 $f(x,y)$ 是连续函数，$D:x^2+y^2\leq a^2(a>0)$，则二重积分 $\iint_Df(x,y)dxdy$ 可化累次积分为[\quad] $2a\int_0^a dy\int_{-\sqrt{a^2-y^2}}^{\sqrt{a^2-y^2}}f(x,y)dx$ $2\int_0^a dy\int_{-\sqrt{a^2-y^2}}^{\sqrt{a^2-y^2}}f(x,y)dx$ $\int_{-a}^adx\int_{-\sqrt{a^2-x^2}}^{\sqrt{a^2-x^2}}f(x,y)dy$ $2\int_0^adx\int_{-\sqrt{a^2-x^2}}^{\sqrt{a^2-x^2}}f(x,y)dy$ 解答 原式=$\int_{-a}^{a}dx\int_{-\sqrt{a^2-x^2}}^{\sqrt{a^2-x^2}}f(x,y)dy$，原式=$\int_{-a}^{a}dy\int_{-\sqrt{a^2-y^2}}^{\sqrt{a^2-y^2}}f(x,y)dx$。
